title: First steps in Lean
Lean 的第一步
summary: Five one-line proofs: read the goal, pick one tactic, watch it turn green.
五個一行的證明：讀懂目標、挑一個戰術，看著它變綠。

title: From points to matrices
從點到矩陣
summary: Geometry with whole-number coordinates, then the vectors and 2 × 2 matrices behind it.
用整數座標做幾何，接著是背後的向量與 2 × 2 矩陣。

title: When omega gives up
當 omega 放棄時
summary: omega solves linear arithmetic, but not products of unknowns. Each problem here needs another move: compute, rewrite, a calc chain, or grind.
omega 能解線性算術，卻不能處理未知數相乘。這裡每一題都需要別的招式：計算、改寫、calc 推導鏈，或 grind。

title: Building a proof step by step
一步一步搭起證明
summary: Proofs in several moves: each step leaves a smaller goal, until nothing is left.
分好幾步完成的證明：每一步都留下更小的目標，直到什麼都不剩。
